svg.title: Mouse · Agouti
svg.desc: Compact agouti laboratory mouse with ticked brown-gray fur, darker dorsum, lighter underside, large pinnae, and a thin tail. Biological basis: Agouti hairs contain alternating pigment bands that create a grizzled wild-type coat rather than a uniform flat brown.
